_comment: Chapter 2 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F06, Kai the royal knight comes to arrest Leo; his quest (three forest wolves).

text.zh_TW: 一個穿著皇家鎧甲的少年擋在路上，劍已出鞘。「奉王命：收押危險的孩子。就是你吧？手會發光的那個。」
text.en: A boy in royal armour blocks the way, sword drawn. "By order of the crown: the dangerous child is to be contained. That's you, isn't it? The one with glowing hands."

label.en: "I'm only going to save my parents!"

text.zh_TW: 凱愣了一下，收起劍。「……收集者也抓了王都的人。好吧，我先不抓你——但我會一直盯著你。我叫凱。」
text.en: Kai hesitates, then sheathes his sword. "...The Collectors took people from the capital too. Fine. I won't arrest you yet, but I'll be watching you. I'm Kai."

text.zh_TW: 凱揮劍，你一閃——他自己絆了一跤。「……剛才不算！」他爬起來，臉紅到耳根。「我叫凱。我會一直盯著你的。」
text.en: Kai swings; you dodge, and he trips over his own feet. "...That didn't count!" He scrambles up, red to the ears. "I'm Kai. I'll be watching you."

text.zh_TW: 凱：「既然要往上走，幫個忙：森林裡的狼在幫收集者趕人。打倒三隻，我就相信你不是壞人。」
text.en: Kai: "If you're going up anyway, make yourself useful. The forest wolves are herding people for the Collectors. Beat three of them and I'll believe you're not a villain."
